head_commit.message:
Allow Format in jax.numpy.from_dlpack type annotations and docstring.

`jax.dlpack.from_dlpack` supports passing a `Format` object to the `device` parameter to specify an explicit device-local layout during DLPack import. Although `jax.numpy.from_dlpack` forwards `device` directly to `jax.dlpack.from_dlpack`, its function signature, type stub, and docstring still restricted `device` to `Device | Sharding | None`.

Extend the `device` type annotation on `jax.numpy.from_dlpack` and its `.pyi` stub to accept `Format`, and update its docstring to document `Format` placement and format-transfer copy behavior.

name: CI - Wheel Tests (Continuous)
display_title: [jax-buildcop] [Mosaic GPU] Fix race in `ExecuteSync` before unloading GPU module in `custom_call_test`.

head_commit.message:
[jax-buildcop] [Mosaic GPU] Fix race in `ExecuteSync` before unloading GPU module in `custom_call_test`.

Tests such as `UnloadGPUModule` and `GPUModuleIsRecompiledAfterExpiration` assume that once `ExecuteSync(executable.get())` returns on the main thread, `executable` holds the last reference to the underlying `xla::LocalExecutable` (which transitively owns `CustomCallResources` and `KernelHandle`), so calling `executable.reset()` will synchronously run `~KernelHandle()` and log `"Successfully unloaded GPU module"` before `collector.Stop()` stops capturing logs.

However, during `executable->Execute(...)`, `PjRtStreamExecutorRawLoadedExecutable::Execute` registers an `AndThen` cleanup waiter (`[exe = executable, ...]`) on the compute stream's definition event (`tsl::AsyncValue`) that holds an extra `std::shared_ptr<LocalExecutable>`. Calling `result[0][0]->GetReadyFuture()` registers a second `AndThen` waiter on that same event. Because `tsl::AsyncValue` executes `AndThen` waiters in LIFO order on the single-threaded `py_xla_callback` worker, `GetReadyFuture().Await()` wakes the main thread before `py_xla_callback` destroys the `Execute()` cleanup waiter and drops its `std::shared_ptr<LocalExecutable>`. The main thread (`executable.reset()` and `collector.Stop()`) then races with `py_xla_callback` dropping the last reference to `LocalExecutable` and unloading the GPU module.

Explicitly wait in `ExecuteSync` (with a 5-second deadline) until no other references to `xla::LocalExecutable` remain besides the one held by `executable` itself (`local_executable.use_count() == 1`). Also scope VLOG level overrides per-test via `CustomCallTest::SetVLogLevel` (restoring previous levels in `~CustomCallTest()`) and add the missing `SetVLogLevel("custom_call", 5)` in `GPUModuleIsRecompiledAfterExpiration`.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1011826759

head_commit.message:
[jax-buildcop] Skip `testDotProductAttentionJitGrad` when CUDA compute capability is insufficient

`nn.dot_product_attention(..., implementation='xla')` uses `DotAlgorithmPreset.BF16_BF16_F32` for `bfloat16` and `DotAlgorithmPreset.F16_F16_F32` for `float16`. Inside `jax.jit`, XLA GPU requires CUDA compute capability >= 8.0 for `BF16_BF16_F32` and >= 7.0 for `F16_F16_F32`, so skip `testDotProductAttentionJitGrad` on older CUDA GPUs where those dot algorithms are unsupported.

head_commit.message:
[partitioning] Lower unary ops to explicit shard_map rules.

Instead of relying on the partitioner, register an explicit shard_map rule for
unary elementwise ops (`unop`) so explicit-mesh partitioning stays at the JAX
level.
